Default the four fencing skills among themselves at -3 while preserving separately listed sword defaults.
Apply improved retreat, halved repeated-parry penalty, encumbrance and breakage; forbid parrying flails.
Remove off-hand and knife parry penalties for defense only; retain the off-hand attack penalty and ordinary knife skill for primary-hand use.
Apply block -2 and parry -4; forbid fencing/knife parries and retain additional unarmed penalties. Attack prevents that weapon parrying in the same turn.
Default one- and two-handed flail skills at -3; keep the other printed defaults separate.
Default the impact pair at -3 and prohibit same-turn parry after an attack.
Become unready after attacking but not after parrying; enforce required two-hand use and weapon-specific readiness exceptions.
Grant the trained staff parry bonus +2 only with eligible use and preserve the ordinary spear relationship.
Grant +2 in the disarm contest and bypass the initial weapon hit roll only immediately after a qualifying parry; still consume an attack.
Apply the ordinary -1 knife parry penalty unless an explicit trained exception applies.
Apply maximum length, minimum striking distance for long whips, slow readiness, entanglement and poor-parry procedures. Energy whips cannot automatically entangle.
Use -3 among the four whip-family skills, retaining the weighted-chain flail default.
Own the grip state; check switching with free success, turn-consuming failure and critical drop. The forearm grip changes close-combat damage and parry.
Replace will only against eligible mental attacks while conscious, awake and unstunned; require martial eligibility or the explicitly approved magical/psychic exception.
Assess authored prices and availability; opposed haggling changes fair value by ten percent. Apply trained reaction bonuses and separately stacked culture/area restrictions.
Apply the illegal-goods penalty unless streetwise reaches twelve or the purchased specialty covers those goods; preserve other social-trait modifiers.
Identify or analyze authored metals and processing problems without granting an intelligence default.

Resolve one secret check per forecast day and make later predictions fail after the first failure. Require world-type specialization from technology five onward. At technology levels zero through four, use the low-technology alias and grant plus two in the home area; it shares the same skill investment. Equipment bonuses require actual training rather than a default.
Verify next-day through fifth-day penalties and the continuing -2 per day; apply low-technology home-region bonus and technology-dependent equipment, denying good-equipment bonuses to default users.
